_about: Expected HIPAA Safe Harbor treatment of the spans that matter. Any span not listed is expected to be KEPT, so redacting it counts as over-redaction. 'trap' names the reason a text-only approach tends to get the span wrong.

01_enrollment_log.txt.why: A site coordinator is not the individual, a relative, an employer or a household member (A).
A document version date is not about an individual (C).
A random study code is an allowed re-identification code (§164.514(c)).
Birth date of someone now 92: even the year is indicative of age over 89 (C).
Enrollment date relates to the individual; keep year only (C).
Birth date; year allowed since the subject is 68 (C).
Enrollment date relates to the individual (C).

02_sae_narrative.txt.why: Protocol approval date is not about an individual (C).
Ages over 89 must be aggregated to 90 or older (C).
Town is a geographic subdivision smaller than a state (B).
ZIP3 049 covers more than 20,000 people, so the first 3 digits may stay (B).
Name of a relative of the individual (A).
An eponymous disease name is not a person's name.
The investigator is not the individual, a relative, an employer or a household member (A).
Specimen label built from the subject's initials and birth date, which are only known from the enrollment log: not an allowed re-identification code (§164.514(c)).
Sample collection date relates to the individual (C).

03_monitoring_note.txt.why: The date of a site monitoring visit is about the site, not an individual (C).
The monitor is not the individual (A).
A birth year alone is allowed when it implies an age under 90 (C).
ZIP3 036 covers 20,000 people or fewer, so it must become 000 (B).
A publicized personal event that also reveals a 1934 birth year: a unique identifying characteristic (R) that needs human review.
A cell line name, not a person's name.
Reagent lot number, not about an individual.

04_sample_manifest.txt.why: Shipment date is about the shipment, not an individual (C).
Sample ID built from the subject's medical record number, which is only known from the enrollment log (H, §164.514(c)).
